topics.topic: Whether flow-activation authority permits draft-write sends
questions: Does this outcome also permit a `draft-write` send under the flow activation, as the trigger and steps 2–3 require?
Must the stated outcome include `draft-write` sends authorized by the flow activation, in addition to sends authorized by an exact approval or a standing grant?

quotes:
The effect sent once, on the exact request the owner was shown or under the
owner's grant, with the declared idempotency key; its EffectAttempt `applied`,
`not_applied`, `not_sent` or `unknown`, and the authority it used.
judgement.why: The outcome limits authorized sends to an exact approval or standing grant, while the flow steps expressly authorize ordinary draft-write sends through the FlowActivation.

topics.topic: Handling a StandingGrant targeting a function node with no effect class
questions: What happens when the named node is a function node and therefore has no effect class?

topics.topic: Scope of the once-only send guarantee
questions: Does “sent once” mean one HTTP request per EffectAttempt, or at most one send for the element over its entire run?

topics.topic: Startup operation-specific checks when no operation name is provided
questions: Which A08 rule 5 operation-specific checks are run at startup when `check_installed_instances` has a service and selected instance but no operation name?

topics.topic: Whether cleanup failure after an explicit try invalidates an existing AdmissionVerdict
questions: Does the claim that no verdict exists and admission reruns apply only when cleanup failed during admission, or also when it failed during an explicit try that may already have an AdmissionVerdict for the current corpus?
